mobile.accounts.browser_waiting: Finish signing in on {{server}}'s page. The app continues on its own once you're done.
mobile.accounts.fetch_keys_hint: Messages that couldn't be decrypted can be read once their keys come from your key backup. This happens on its own after verifying; try it again if some still can't be read.
mobile.accounts.license: Free software under the MIT license
mobile.accounts.no_code: The server didn't send a link or code.
mobile.accounts.notifications_hint: When rooms notify you, unless a room has its own setting. Change a single room from its menu. Saved on your homeserver, so your other apps follow it.
mobile.accounts.sign_out_hint: Its messages and keys are removed from this device. Keep your recovery key or another signed-in session, so you can read your encrypted messages after signing in again.
mobile.accounts.third_party_hint: The main libraries Better Matrix is built with, each with its version and license.
